title: Minimum Number of Flips to Make Binary Grid Palindromic I
summary: Given an m x n binary matrix, determine the least number of cell flips required to make all rows or all columns palindromic.
statement: Given an m x n binary matrix, determine the least number of cell flips required to make all rows or all columns palindromic.
constraints: grid is a nonempty rectangular binary matrix with at most 200,000 cells.
Flip cells to make either every row palindromic or every column palindromic.
Return the smaller required flip count.
hints: A mirrored pair needs one flip exactly when its cells differ.
Total horizontal disagreements for rows and vertical disagreements for columns independently.
Compare each pair once and return the smaller total.
Pairs in either orientation are disjoint, so mismatch costs add and no cheaper repair exists.
editorial: Pairs in either orientation are disjoint, so mismatch costs add and no cheaper repair exists.

tests.explanation: Two mirrored row pairs disagree, so two flips make every row palindromic.
The columns contain one vertically mirrored mismatch, so one flip suffices.
